question: What Is an ISA 5.4 Instrument Loop Diagram?
body_html:
ISA 5.4 instrument loop diagrams show one complete loop, with every device, terminal, cable, junction box and control system channel from the field device to the operator. Key contents include:

ContentWhat It Shows
IdentificationLoop number and every tag per ISA 5.1
Point to point connectionsCables, pairs, core colours, terminals, junction boxes
Device locationsField, marshalling, system cabinet, control room
Energy sourcesPower supply, fuse number, instrument air
ActionsDirect or reverse action, valve fail position
